body.x: Fairip will show 'GAK KSL & ESL' at CES 2019, theworld's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to11 (Fri), 2019.

Founded in April 2017, Fairip focuses on language education services using a new medium called Virtual Reality (VR). Fairip's 'GAK KSL & ESL' is a 360 ° video that tells you the pronunciation, shows the image of the word in question, and helps you to guess.

Fairip said, "It has great educational effect becauseit is learning to experience directly in VR environment, not simply learning toread and write." As a result of conducting research on 5 domestic middleschools, the result of 95% of participants had a 30% improvement on theirscores."

"Fairip's VR Koreanis working with BTS product delivery companies to prepare Korean languageeducation products using BTS characters," he said. Currently, Fairip islooking for an investment company to acquire a BTS license and is targeting theUS and European and Southeast Asian markets.

On the other hand,Daejeon Center for Creative Economy and Innovation is carrying out educationalprograms on the fostering of venture enterprises in Daejeon that are small butstrong. They are helping companies with various activities such as Dream VentureStar (DVS), economic cooperation industry development project, technologyinnovation type enterprise support project (open voucher) and actively makingefforts to support CES 2019 participation. The following companies areparticipating in CES 2019 with support from the Daejeon Center for CreativeEconomy and Innovation. ▲ News Dog Ventures ▲ Classum ▲ Fairip. These companieswill also participate in 'MIK Night' organized by AVING news on the 3rd day ofthe exhibition.
